items.q: What are the Three Ms for AI leverage?
items.a: **Mindset, Method, Machine**: default to "how could AI do **30%** of this?", break jobs into automatable chunks, and treat AI as a **mentor**, not a vending machine.

items.q: What order do the Four Cs require?
items.a: **Context → Connections → Capabilities → Cadence**. You cannot skip steps — cadence needs connections, and capabilities need context first.

items.q: Should you expect a productivity dip when adopting an AIOS?
items.a: Yes — expect about a **~20% short-term loss**, then an exponential payoff by roughly **week two**.

items.q: How do you keep an AIOS from dying when tools change?
items.a: Build a **tool-agnostic durable layer**: context files, **API reference markdown**, and skills that survive model churn. Nate migrated his AIOS to Codex in about **~2 minutes**.

items.q: Why use dedicated AI service accounts?
items.a: Create separate API keys/accounts (e.g. **"Up AI" in ClickUp**) with **scoped permissions** instead of wiring your full-access personal credentials.

items.q: Why prefer API reference docs over MCP?
items.a: Research an integration once, save endpoints as **local markdown** — better **token efficiency** than MCP. Hardcode frequently used IDs in skills after watching agent behavior.

items.q: How do Claude Code skills load tokens efficiently?
items.a: Skills live at `.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` with YAML front matter. **Progressive disclosure**: name/description first (**~100 tokens**), full skill on invoke, references/scripts only when needed. Skills are **SOPs for agents**.

items.q: What are the three tiers of cadence?
items.a: **Cloud routines** (GitHub + env vars, laptop off), **desktop scheduled tasks** (local/remote), and **`/loop`** (same-session cron, **3-day expiry**, minutely intervals).

items.q: When should you skip agents for boring automation?
items.a: **Deterministic workflows beat AI agents** about **nine times out of ten**. Break processes into chunks — many chunks need plumbing, not autonomy.

items.q: How do you know an AIOS is working?
items.a: Subjective KPIs: your team can **ask the AIOS instead of you**, you **stop opening new tabs**, and knowledge **leaves your head** into the system. Proof of concept with Claude artifacts before custom dashboards.
